children: Iambic Therapeutics filed for an initial public offering on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker “IAM.” The AI-native biopharma integrates proprietary large-scale AI with automated chemistry and biology to design and advance small-molecule drugs. Proceeds are earmarked to progress lead oncology programs and general corporate purposes.

Iambic Therapeutics is a technology‑driven biopharmaceutical company using proprietary, large‑scale AI and automated experimentation to discover and develop small‑molecule medicines. Its platform integrates Enchant, a multimodal transformer model that predicts preclinical and clinical properties, with NeuralPLexer, a generative structure engine for protein–ligand complexes, and a closed‑loop automated lab to rapidly design–make–test compounds.

The company’s lead program, IAM1363, is an oral, highly selective, pan‑mutant, brain‑penetrant HER2 inhibitor in an ongoing Phase 1/1b basket study, with plans to initiate a registrational trial as early as 2027 subject to regulatory feedback. Two additional candidates—IAM217 (a brain‑penetrant, allosteric KIF18A inhibitor) and IAM‑C1 (a selective dual CDK2/4 inhibitor)—are in preclinical development with planned IND submissions in Q4 2026. Iambic also partners with large pharmas and tech companies to deploy its platform across additional targets and indications.

: Company estimates multi‑billion‑dollar opportunities across HER2‑driven cancers and other indications, including >$10B for IAM1363 and IAM‑C1, >$5B for IAM217, and ~$70B across discovery-stage programs.
: AI‑enabled discovery and automation aim to shorten timelines and improve success rates versus traditional drug development.

: An integrated “molecular superintelligence” platform combining multimodal AI (Enchant), generative structure prediction (NeuralPLexer) and automated labs positions Iambic as a next‑gen discovery company.
: Recursion, Relay Therapeutics, Generate Biomedicines, Insilico Medicine, Isomorphic Labs, Xaira, AbCellera, Absci, XtalPi, among others.
: Rapid advances in frontier AI, expansion of high‑throughput experimentation, growing pharma partnerships, and an increasing focus on CNS‑active and mutant‑selective targeted therapies.
